summary: Closure review: the authors addressed the prior required revisions. The manuscript now explicitly discloses that execution used shared_initial_candidate semantics (execution_contract.independent_condition_generation=false), documents the preregistration ↔ executed‑design mismatch and its consequence for the preregistered power/MDE, and provides artifact pointers and SHA‑256 hashes for the deterministic verifier rule set and representative scoring JSONs. All mandatory disclosures appear within the archived five‑page material and the Disclosure Statement. The reported conditional null result (n11=270, n10=n01=n00=0) is consistent with the archived artifacts and the analysis outputs. No new critical reproducibility or mandatory‑disclosure defects remain.
optional_revisions: Add a one‑line artifact checklist in Methods listing the minimal files and their SHA‑256s required to reproduce the two sampling variants (shared candidate vs independent per‑arm).

If space permits, include a short excerpt (one or two lines) from a verifier diagnostic in an existing scoring JSON to illustrate the rejection/diagnostic format (use archived artifact; no new execution).
Explicitly label the reported inference as a conditional result in the title subtitle or first sentence of the Abstract to maximize clarity for readers skimming the paper.
